test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

Mount Everest is a peak in the Himalaya mountain range.

P. It is located between Nepal and Tibet, an autonomous region of China.

Q. At 8,849 meters (29,032 feet), it is considered the tallest point on Earth.

R. In the nineteenth century, the mountain was named after George Everest, a former Surveyor General of India.

S. The Tibetan name is Chomolungma, which means "Mother Goddess of the World."

The Nepali name is Sagarmatha, which has various meanings.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **PQRS**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• By analyzing the information and logical flow of each sentence, we can determine the correct order:
 
• The** first **and **last sentences** are fixed:
 
 
• Mount Everest is a peak in the Himalaya mountain range. **[Fixed as the first sentence]**
 
• The Nepali name is Sagarmatha, which has various meanings.** [Fixed as the last sentence]**
 
 
 
• **P. **It is located between Nepal and Tibet, an autonomous region of China.
 
 
• This sentence provides information about the geographical location of Mount Everest, stating that it is situated between Nepal and Tibet.
 
 
 
• **Q.** At 8,849 meters (29,032 feet), it is considered the tallest point on Earth.
 
 
• Sentence Q highlights the impressive height of Mount Everest, explaining that it is recognized as the tallest point on Earth.
 
 
 
• **R.** In the nineteenth century, the mountain was named after George Everest, a former Surveyor General of India.
 
 
• Sentence R provides historical information about the naming of Mount Everest after George Everest, who was a former Surveyor General of India.
 
 
 
• **S.** The Tibetan name is Chomolungma, which means "Mother Goddess of the World."
 
 
• Sentence S introduces the Tibetan name for Mount Everest, which is Chomolungma and its translation meaning "Mother Goddess of the World."
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct order of the sentences is **PQRS**.
